messages:
marie: Heads-up: PR #9874 touches security-sensitive examples (KMS/sample keys). Needs sec + legal review before merge. CI preview below — one broken link and a snippet that looks like a plaintext key. Can we get eyes today?

ci-bot: Docs preview for PR 9874: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/9874 — build: passed, link-check: failed (1 broken link). Files changed: docs/security-sensitive.md

alex: I can scrub the snippet and push a tiny patch. Quick q: what's the canonical redaction pattern here? use <REDACTED_KEY> or show env var example?

sam: Security: please do not check in anything that even resembles a secret. Use an env-var pattern or Secret Manager example. Also: we require a redaction request ticket for docs that reference keys — creating sec-214 now.

jamal: Legal: will review for PHI/PCI concerns. If you replace real-looking tokens with placeholders and add a handling note we should be fine. Add a link to the compliance checklist in the PR.

marie: Filing sec-214 and linking it in the PR. I'm pushing a patch that replaces the inline key with process.env.KMS_KEY and adds a short comment about never committing secrets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9874

marie: Example (before):
```javascript
// BAD - leaked-looking example
const kmsKey = "AKIAEXAMPLEPLAINTEXTKEY123"
// usage...
```

marie: Example (after):
```javascript
// GOOD - use env / secret manager
const kmsKey = process.env.KMS_KEY // inject via CI/secret manager
// never store secrets in repo
```

alex: That fix looks good. Please add a changelog note and link to sec-214. I can approve and merge during today's docs merge window (4–5pm PT) once sec + legal sign off.

sam: Sec-214 created and linked in the PR. Reviewed the updated snippet; one suggestion: show SecretManager usage snippet (one line) instead of raw env var to nudge best practice. Also add a sentence to the top of the page: "Do not paste real keys; use secret manager or env injection."

jamal: Legal quick confirm: no PHI, no regulatory flags from our side. :thumbsup:

kayla: I fixed the broken link that CI caught (was pointing to an old internal KB). Updated the anchor — preview rebuilt.

ci-bot: Preview updated: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/9874 — build: succeeded, link-check: passed.

marie: Thanks everyone. Merging in the 4–5pm PT window at ~4:15pm PT unless anyone objects. If you want a different merge time call it out now. :eyes:

alex: No objections from me, will watch the merge and rollout steps. :shipit:

sam: all good from security after the SecretManager inline suggestion — mark as approved.

jamal: Approved from Legal.

marie: Merged at 4:17pm PT. Closing sec-214 and adding a follow-up doc note to the contributor guide about redaction patterns. Thanks!
